## Emergency Order for the Protection of the Greater Sage-Grouse {#emergency-order-for-the-protection-of-the-greater-sage-grouse .Title-of-Act}

[SOR]{.abbr title="Statutory Orders and Regulations"}/2013-202
:::

[SPECIES AT RISK ACT](/eng/acts/S-15.3)

Registration 2013-11-20

Emergency Order for the Protection of the Greater Sage-Grouse

P.C. 2013-1245 2013-11-18
::::

::::::::::::::: section
::: {.section .order}
Whereas the Minister of the Environment is of the opinion that the
Greater Sage-Grouse faces imminent threats to its survival and recovery;

Therefore, His Excellency the Governor General in Council, on the
recommendation of the Minister of the Environment, pursuant to section
80 and subsection 97(2) of the [Species at Risk
Act](/eng/acts/S-15.3)[[Footnote
]{.wb-invisible}^a^](#fn_1500_ec_160){#fn_1500_ec_160-ID0EDBAA}, makes
the annexed Emergency Order for the Protection of the Greater
Sage-Grouse.

- ::: Footnote
  [[Return to footnote
  ]{.wb-invisible}^a^](#fn_1500_ec_160-ID0EDBAA){#fn_1500_ec_160}S.C.
  2002, c. 29
  :::
:::

## [Interpretation]{.HTitleText1} {#h-795410 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1 .sectionLabel}** The following definitions
apply in this Order.

[[agricultural operation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[agricultural operation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning
    assigned by the laws of the province in which the operation takes
    place. ([activité agricole]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[legal subdivision]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[legal subdivision]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or
    [[LSD]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a unit of land described in the
    Dominion Land Survey System that is 1/4 of a quarter-section and has
    an area of approximately 16 ha or 400 m by 400 m. ([subdivision
    officielle]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [subd.
    off.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[quarter-section]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[quarter-section]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a unit of land
    described in the Dominion Land Survey System that has an area of
    approximately 64 ha or 800 m by 800 m. ([quart de
    section]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

## [Non-Application]{.HTitleText1} {#h-795416 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

**[[1.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.1 .sectionLabel}** Despite paragraph 2(b)
and subsections 3(7) and (8), this Order does not apply to

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} legal subdivision 12 of the northwest quarter-section
  of section 29, township 2, range 29 and west of the third meridian;
  and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} legal subdivisions 3, 4, 5 and 6 of the southwest
  quarter-section of section 29, township 2, range 29 and west of the
  third meridian.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2014-54, s. 1
:::

## [Habitat]{.HTitleText1} {#h-795423 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Alberta and Saskatchewan

**[[2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-2 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
paragraph 80(4)(c) of the [Species at Risk Act](/eng/acts/S-15.3), the
following areas are identified as habitat that is necessary for the
survival or recovery of the Greater Sage-Grouse:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in Alberta, the area that is composed of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the legal subdivisions of the quarter-sections that
    are listed in column 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 for which a provision
    is set out in any of columns 2 to 5,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the parts of road allowances that are between any
    two legal subdivisions referred to in subparagraph (i) and that are
    contiguous to them, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the parts formed by the intersection of two road
    allowances whose four corners each touch a legal subdivision
    referred to in subparagraph (i); and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in Saskatchewan, the area that is composed of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the legal subdivisions of the quarter-sections that
    are listed in column 1 of Part 2 of Schedule 1 for which a provision
    is set out in any of columns 2 to 5,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the parts of road allowances that are between any
    two legal subdivisions referred to in subparagraph (i) and that are
    contiguous to them, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the parts formed by the intersection of two road
    allowances whose four corners each touch a legal subdivision
    referred to in subparagraph (i).

## [Prohibitions]{.HTitleText1} {#h-795434 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibited activities

- **[[3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-3 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  following activities are prohibited:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} killing sagebrush plants, native grasses or native
    forbs in a legal subdivision or road allowance, other than

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in any part of the legal subdivision or road
      allowance that was used for growing and harvesting non-native
      plants at any given time in 2011, 2012 or 2013, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in an area that is on or within 15 m of the edge
      of a road;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} moving sagebrush plants, native grasses or native
    forbs from or within a legal subdivision or road allowance, other
    than

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} from or within any part of the legal subdivision
      or road allowance that was used for growing and harvesting
      non-native plants at any given time in 2011, 2012 or 2013, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in an area that is on or within 15 m of the edge
      of a road;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} installing or constructing a fence in a legal
    subdivision or road allowance;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} installing or constructing, in a legal subdivision
    or road allowance, a structure or machine that produces a noise that
    exceeds 45 dB(A) for a total daily duration of at least 60 minutes
    in at least 10 days of any given month, or a structure that houses a
    machine that produces such a noise in a location where such a noise
    did not exist on the date of the coming into force of this Order, or
    altering a structure or machine that exists on the date of the
    coming into force of this Order, in a legal subdivision or road
    allowance, or its use, in a way that results in the structure or
    machine producing such a noise;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} constructing a new road or widening a road that
    exists on the date of the coming into force of this Order, in a
    legal subdivision or road allowance; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} installing or constructing a structure --- other
    than a fence --- machine or pole that is greater than 1.2 m in
    height in a legal subdivision or road allowance, or increasing the
    height of a structure --- other than a fence --- machine or pole
    that exists on the date of the coming into force of this Order
    beyond that height in a legal subdivision or road allowance.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type of road

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Paragraphs (1)(a), (b) and (e) only apply to a road
  that is paved, oiled, graded or levelled using heavy machinery and
  that is for the use of motor vehicles.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Paragraphs (1)(a) to (c) do not apply in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the installation or construction, in a legal
    subdivision or road allowance, of a fence to manage grazing animals
    that conforms to the standards set out in Schedule 2; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the installation or construction, in a legal
    subdivision or road allowance, of a watering system to manage
    grazing animals, if the installation or construction does not result
    in the destruction of more than 30 m^2^ of an area that is covered
    with sagebrush plants, native grasses or native forbs in that legal
    subdivision or road allowance.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Watering system

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraph (3)(b), a watering
  system must not occupy an area on or above the ground that is more
  than 30 m^2^, must not include a dam and must not have any pipes with
  a diameter of 11 cm or more.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Paragraphs (1)(a) to (f) do not apply either inside
  or within 100 m of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a residential building that exists on the date of
    the coming into force of this Order;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a building that is used for the purposes of an
    agricultural operation if it exists on the date of the coming into
    force of this Order;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a shelter that is used for the purposes of an
    agricultural operation if it remains at the same place where it was
    located on the date of the coming into force of this Order; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a structure or machine that is used to feed,
    handle, treat or provide water to grazing animals if it is used at
    the same place where it was used before the coming into force of
    this Order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Installing or constructing --- meaning

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraphs (1)(c), (d) and (f),
  installing or constructing does not include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} reconstructing or repairing a pole or structure ---
    including a fence --- that exists on the date of the coming into
    force of this Order or replacing it with a pole or structure ---
    including a fence --- whose dimensions do not exceed those of the
    existing pole or structure; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} reconstructing or repairing a structure or machine
    that produces a noise and that exists on the date of the coming into
    force of this Order or replacing it with a structure or machine
    whose dimensions and noise levels do not exceed those of the
    existing structure or machine.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application --- paragraphs (1)(a) and
  (b)

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} Paragraphs (1)(a) and (b) apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the legal subdivisions of the quarter-sections that
    are listed in column 1 of Part 1 or 2 of Schedule 1 for which
    "3(1)(a) to (f)" or "3(1)(a) to (f) and 4" is set out in any of
    columns 2 to 5;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the parts of road allowances that are between any
    two legal subdivisions referred to in paragraph (a) and that are
    contiguous to them; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the parts formed by the intersection of two road
    allowances whose four corners each touch a legal subdivision
    referred to in paragraph (a).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application --- paragraphs (1)(c) to
  (f)

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} Paragraphs (1)(c) to (f) apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the legal subdivisions of the quarter-sections that
    are listed in column 1 of Part 1 or 2 of Schedule 1 for which
    "3(1)(a) to (f)", "3(1)(a) to (f) and 4" or "3(1)(c) to (f) and 4"
    is set out in any of columns 2 to 5;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the parts of road allowances that are between any
    two legal subdivisions referred to in paragraph (a) and that are
    contiguous to them; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the parts formed by the intersection of two road
    allowances whose four corners each touch a legal subdivision
    referred to in paragraph (a).

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibited acute sensory disturbances

- **[[4]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person
  must not operate a facility, motor vehicle or machine that produces a
  noise that exceeds 45 dB(A) at any given time between 1.5 hours before
  sunset to 1.5 hours after sunrise during the period beginning on April
  1 and ending on May 30 of any given year, within a legal subdivision
  or road allowance.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sunset and sunrise times

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Sunset and sunrise times are established by using the
  forecast of Environment Canada for the location that is closest to the
  location to which a prohibition applies under subsection (1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply either inside or within
  100 m of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a residential building that exists on the date of
    the coming into force of this Order;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a building that is used for the purposes of an
    agricultural operation if it exists on the date of the coming into
    force of this Order;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a shelter that is used for the purposes of an
    agricultural operation if it remains at the same place where it was
    located on the date of the coming into force of this Order; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a structure or machine that is used to feed,
    handle, treat or provide water to grazing animals if it is used at
    the same place where it was used before the coming into force of
    this Order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The prohibition against operating a motor vehicle
  that produces a noise that exceeds 45 dB(A) during the period set out
  in subsection (1) does not apply to a person who operates a motor
  vehicle

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to or from a residential building;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to or from a place where that person is conducting
    an agricultural operation; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} to visit a person who is conducting an agricultural
    operation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} This section applies to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the legal subdivisions of the quarter-sections that
    are listed in column 1 of Part 1 or 2 of Schedule 1 for which
    "3(1)(a) to (f) and 4" or "3(1)(c) to (f) and 4" is set out in any
    of columns 2 to 5;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the parts of road allowances that are between any
    two legal subdivisions referred to in paragraph (a) and that are
    contiguous to them; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the parts formed by the intersection of two road
    allowances whose four corners each touch a legal subdivision
    referred to in paragraph (a).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2017-223, s. 1(E)
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

**[[5]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5 .sectionLabel}** The prohibitions do not
apply to a person engaging in activities related to public safety or
health, or to the health of animals and plants, that are authorized
under provincial law.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Offences

**[[6]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-6 .sectionLabel}** Paragraphs 3(1)(a) to (f)
and subsection 4(1) may give rise to offences under section 97 of the
[Species at Risk Act](/eng/acts/S-15.3).

::::: section
:::: {#795524 .Schedule}
::: {}
## [SCHEDULE 2]{.scheduleLabel}[(Paragraph 3(3)(a))]{.OriginatingRef}[Standards for Design and Construction of Fences in Greater Sage-Grouse Habitat]{.scheduleTitleText}  {#h-795525 .scheduleLabel}
:::

- **1** A fence for grazing animals other than bison must not be greater
  than 1.2 m in height and must be constructed with a maximum of four
  wires that are single-, double- or triple-stranded and that are
  parallel to the ground, but must not be constructed of page wire,
  chicken wire, chain link or other similar woven wire.

- **2** A fence for bison must not be greater than 1.7 m in height and
  must be constructed with a maximum of five wires that are single-,
  double- or triple-stranded and that are parallel to the ground, but
  must not be constructed of page wire, chicken wire, chain link or
  other similar woven wire.

- **3** The top wire must be barbless.

- **4** The top two wires must be marked with flagging or reflectors
  that are spaced at intervals of not more than 1.5 m.

- **5** Fence posts must be designed to deter perching by avian
  predators of the Greater Sage-Grouse, including by fitting the posts
  with deterrent devices such as spikes, caps or cones or, in the case
  of metal fence posts, by cutting them at an angle of approximately
  45°.
